robmon.title: RobMon
robmon.blurb: A creature-raising and battle game on Roblox. Hatch a RobMon from an egg, raise and breed it on your own island plot, train it, then send your team into auto-battles to climb the arena ladder.
points: Every RobMon is modelled in Blender by Python scripts, using only shapes Roblox has 1:1, then rebuilt part-for-part in Studio
Server-side battle engine, NPC trainer ladder, global leaderboards and saved player data
Breeding with DNA, potential, shiny variants, gear, shops, quests and fast travel between islands
Built with AI pair-programming (Claude Code) through the Roblox Studio and Blender MCP servers

claudeTools.title: claude-tools
claudeTools.blurb: Small Windows helpers I use every day with Claude Code. Pure PowerShell 5.1 and WinForms, so nothing needs installing.
tools: Lists my projects and opens one in the IDE, Terminal or Claude Desktop with Claude already running. Links each project to its own Obsidian vault.
An always-on-top side tab and tray icon that show my 5-hour and weekly usage limits.
A side tab that lists running Claude sessions, their folders and MCP connections, with plugin toggles.
